card.name: Inside rare split-up words
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a rare word that is split into several parts, such as the 'ith' in telithromycin, the 'ite' in élite, and 'oid' in Meteoroid.

modes.label: Telithromycin
modes.description: The 'ith' piece inside the antibiotic name telithromycin in lists of interacting drugs.

modes.description: The ending 'ite' of the accented word élite in political commentary.
